senses.gloss: (b. h.) pr. n. m. Ham, the son of Noah.
units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 69b:15">Snh. 69ᵇ</cite> <he>ח׳ גדול וכ׳</he> H. was the elder of Japheth by one year &c.

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 108b:15">Ib. 108ᵇ</cite> <he>ח׳ לקה בעורו</he> H. was punished on his skin (was made black); <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 36:7">Gen. R. s. 36</cite> <he>יצא ח׳ מפוהם</he> Ḥ. came out (of the ark) blackened; a. e.
